pageDescription: Configure Ollama or LM Studio for editable AI reply drafts in the mail composer. These settings are personal and apply to this workspace only.

form.title: AI reply assistant
form.description: Kurrier can use Ollama or LM Studio for reply drafts. A draft is only inserted into the editor; it is never sent automatically.
form.baseUrlHint: The address is contacted by the Kurrier server, not by your browser.
form.apiKeySavedHint: A token is saved. Leave empty to keep it, or enter a new token.
form.apiKeyHint: Leave empty when authentication is disabled.
form.clearApiKey: Remove saved token and connect without authentication
form.systemPromptPlaceholder: Example: Reply concisely and politely, in the language of the original email. Do not invent facts.

panel.instructionPlaceholder: AI reply notes: e.g. politely decline, keep it short, suggest a meeting next week…
panel.hint: Uses your configured AI provider to draft text into the editor. Nothing is sent until you review it and press Send.
panel.confirmReplace: Replace the text you have already written with the AI draft?
panel.insertedHint: Review and edit it before sending.

errors.urlCredentials: The AI base URL must not contain credentials.
